mapper.sql: id, name, type, threshold, amount, scope, category_id, total, received, per_limit, start_time, end_time, status, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.type, c.threshold, c.amount, c.scope, c.category_id, c.total, c.received, c.per_limit, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.status, c.create_time FROM `coupon` c WHERE c.status = 1 AND (c.start_time IS NULL OR c.start_time <= NOW()) AND (c.end_time IS NULL OR c.end_time >= NOW()) AND (c.total = 0 OR c.received < c.total) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user_coupon` uc WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.coupon_id = c.id) < c.per_limit ORDER BY c.threshold ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE `coupon` SET received = received + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND (total = 0 OR received < total)
